background.$description: Page background. The bottom layer that everything else sits on. Inside a surface, also the inset fill for code blocks and neutral badges.

subtle.$description: Cards, popovers, and modals, and tinted areas on the background: code blocks, neutral badges, progress tracks, sidebars. One step from the background in both themes.

strong.$description: Hover fill for list items, ghost buttons, and other transparent elements, on the background or a surface.

stronger.$description: Pressed fill for list items, ghost buttons, and other transparent elements, on the background or a surface.

base.$description: Flipped fill for primary buttons, tooltips, and snackbars. Use content/inverse/* on it.

strong.$description: Hover fill for primary buttons. Use content/inverse/* on it.

stronger.$description: Pressed fill for primary buttons. Use content/inverse/* on it.

base.$description: Default text and icons on the background and surfaces.

subtle.$description: Secondary text and icons on the background and surfaces: captions, placeholders, metadata.

base.$description: Text and icons on inverse fills.

subtle.$description: Secondary text and icons on inverse fills.

base.$description: Boundaries of controls such as inputs and checkboxes. Meets 3:1 against the background and surfaces.

subtle.$description: Decorative dividers and outlines. Exempt from contrast.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring. Use with focus-ring/width and focus-ring/offset. Meets 3:1 against the background and surfaces.

surface.$description: Fill of disabled controls. Exempt from contrast.

content.$description: Text and icons of disabled controls. Exempt from contrast.

border.$description: Border of disabled controls. Exempt from contrast.

scrim.$description: Translucent layer that dims the page behind a modal.

subtle.$description: Soft danger fill for alerts, banners, and badges. Use content/base on it.

base.$description: Strong danger fill for destructive buttons, badges, and tags. Use content/inverse on it.

strong.$description: Hover fill for destructive buttons. Use content/inverse on it.

stronger.$description: Pressed fill for destructive buttons. Use content/inverse on it.

base.$description: Danger text and icons on the background, surfaces, and the danger surface/subtle, such as error messages.

inverse.$description: Text and icons on the danger surface/base, strong, and stronger.

base.$description: Boundary in the danger color, such as an input with an error. Meets 3:1 against the background and surfaces.

subtle.$description: Decorative outline around the danger surface/subtle. Exempt from contrast.
Soft warning fill for alerts, banners, and badges. Use content/base on it.

base.$description: Strong warning fill for warning buttons, badges, and tags. Use content/inverse on it.

strong.$description: Hover fill for warning buttons. Use content/inverse on it.

stronger.$description: Pressed fill for warning buttons. Use content/inverse on it.

base.$description: Warning text and icons on the background, surfaces, and the warning surface/subtle, such as caution messages.

inverse.$description: Text and icons on the warning surface/base, strong, and stronger.

base.$description: Boundary in the warning color. Meets 3:1 against the background and surfaces.

subtle.$description: Decorative outline around the warning surface/subtle. Exempt from contrast.
Soft success fill for alerts, banners, and badges. Use content/base on it.

base.$description: Strong success fill for success buttons, badges, and tags. Use content/inverse on it.

strong.$description: Hover fill for success buttons. Use content/inverse on it.

stronger.$description: Pressed fill for success buttons. Use content/inverse on it.

base.$description: Success text and icons on the background, surfaces, and the success surface/subtle, such as confirmation messages.

inverse.$description: Text and icons on the success surface/base, strong, and stronger.

base.$description: Boundary in the success color. Meets 3:1 against the background and surfaces.

subtle.$description: Decorative outline around the success surface/subtle. Exempt from contrast.
Soft info fill for alerts, banners, and badges. Use content/base on it.

base.$description: Strong info fill for info buttons, badges, and tags. Use content/inverse on it.

strong.$description: Hover fill for info buttons. Use content/inverse on it.

stronger.$description: Pressed fill for info buttons. Use content/inverse on it.

base.$description: Info text and icons on the background, surfaces, and the info surface/subtle, such as help text.

inverse.$description: Text and icons on the info surface/base, strong, and stronger.

base.$description: Boundary in the info color. Meets 3:1 against the background and surfaces.

subtle.$description: Decorative outline around the info surface/subtle. Exempt from contrast.

base.$description: Strong discovery fill for discovery buttons, badges, and tags. Use content/inverse on it.

strong.$description: Hover fill for discovery buttons. Use content/inverse on it.

stronger.$description: Pressed fill for discovery buttons. Use content/inverse on it.

base.$description: Discovery text and icons on the background, surfaces, and the discovery surface/subtle, such as new-feature labels.

inverse.$description: Text and icons on the discovery surface/base, strong, and stronger.

base.$description: Boundary in the discovery color. Meets 3:1 against the background and surfaces.

subtle.$description: Decorative outline around the discovery surface/subtle. Exempt from contrast.
